 The latest value from 2013 is 11 percent, an increase from 10 percent in 2012. In comparison, the world average is 34.3 percent, based on data from 128 countries. Historically, the average for Russia from 1991 to 2013 is 9.6 percent. The minimum value, 9 percent, was reached in 1991 while the maximum of 11 percent was recorded in 2013.
